changes: v1.1 (2026-10-12, user): no replay video; the creation replay is ReplayScripts/ only; the full dataset is <repo>/Dataset.zip (same name for every game, git-ignored)
description: Our standard delivery layout for every game: the creation record (git.log, workflow.jsonl, ReplayScripts/), the project, per-scenario gameplay videos, README screenshots and the packaged build. docs/game-deliverable.md, section 'Dataset layout v1.1', is the prose version of this file; tools/validate-dataset.ps1 checks against this file.

names.zip_place: the game repo's own folder, next to Dataset/ (git-ignored, with the packager's scratch in .dataset/)

entries.name: README.md
entries.what: game, how to play and open it, how to replay the creation, scenario videos, screenshots, licences

entries.name: git.log
entries.what: every commit, oldest first: message, anonymised author, dates, full text diff; binary and LFS files as path + sha256

entries.name: workflow.jsonl
entries.what: editor operations, one row each, written when the operation happened

entries.name: UEProject
entries.what: the project at the release commit, with store content; in the repo the repository itself is the project

entries.name: ReplayScripts
entries.what: scripts that replay the creation headless, with Verification/ (report.json verdict PASS required for complete)

entries.name: Gameplay
entries.what: one video per scenario of the release version
entries.scenario_numbers: distinct, 1 or more; a dataset may hold a subset of the game's scenarios (e.g. rally-racer: S2 only, user decision 2026-10-12)

entries.name: Screenshots
entries.what: the README hero and gallery images, linked from README.md by relative path

entries.name: manifest.json
entries.what: metadata and path, bytes, sha256 of every other file

manifest.complete_requires: replay_verification.pass = true in manifest.json and verdict.pass = true in ReplayScripts/Verification/report.json (the creation replay run end to end, headless, from ReplayScripts/ and verified: files outside Content/ byte-identical, assets equal by structure, game maps equal by actors; known non-content differences listed)

blocking: the account name (exact-token allowlist: zh_XIANG, zh-xiang, WuXiangShan...)
